titles.title: The Maid: Where Milk and Honey Flow

description:
Joy Trinder is an unfortunate woman of orphan background who suffered a miscarriage, and whose only family, her husband, abandoned her and vanished. Leaving behind the husband who never returns, twenty-nine-year-old Joy heads to the Percy Dukedom to survive... The young master of the mansion, who constantly desires her and demands that she remember something. However, unable to even remember that she had shared her milk with him when he was young, all she can do is pray that her master, Edward Percy, loses interest in her as soon as possible. When will the young master of this mansion lose interest in me? Why did my husband leave me? Why, and since when, has my life…
Source: MU
